$description: The candidates of the accent colour of Sprint 11 (issue #50): a full set of the roles of design/tokens.json for each, which `contrast.py accents` measures. `color` and `high-contrast` are named as in the tokens, `notes` says how each value was derived, and `known_fails` names the checks that need no frame and that the set fails, with the reason. The owner chose violet, teal and white at the gate of 2026-10-21 (ADR 0058, decision 5) and the tokens carry those three sets, which a test keeps equal to this file; green was not chosen and stays as a measured candidate.

palette_variants.$description: The accents under the colour-blind palettes (issue #50, the UAT of 2026-10-22). A palette changes the status colours and the accent did not change, so an accent could be told from a status colour by nobody the palette is for: violet is 9.3 and 5.0 from the sky blue success of the red-green palette as a protanope and a deuteranope see it. A variant is the full set of roles of an accent under one palette, for the accents whose own set is short of the palette rule: the `accent`, the `accent-soft` and the colours of high contrast are 20 or more (CIEDE2000) from each of the four status colours as normal vision and the vision of the palette see them (the Machado matrices of ColourMeasures.kt), and the variant keeps every contrast rule that its accent keeps. A pair that keeps the 20 has no variant and keeps its accent. A variant is chosen to be 21 or more from them where it can be, as the sets that pass have 20.5 or more to spare and the model of colour vision is an approximation. The strong accent and the line are measured and not held (PALETTE_HELD_ROLES in contrast.py). `contrast.py accents` prints the distances as Table X, and `--palette` measures the accents as that palette draws them. The variants are proposals: the tokens and the app do not have them yet.

violet.label: Violet, Red-green palette
violet.source: No violet variant exists for this palette. To a protanope and a deuteranope violet is a blue, as the sky blue of the success colour (#56B4E9) is: the colours within 45 degrees of the hue of violet (OKLCH 293.5) that are 20 from the four status colours and from the ink are all darker than L 0.57 (Y 0.17), where an accent has 3.5:1 or less on surface-raised and under 4.5:1 on the tint of a selected row (#755AD8, the nearest, is 3.35:1 and 2.96:1), and none of them is light enough to carry text over the glass as the soft accent does (Y 0.49 or more). The nearest colour of any hue that keeps the 20 and every contrast rule that violet keeps is this pale rose. The other ways are to leave violet as it is under this palette, which fails the 20 for a protanope and a deuteranope, and to draw the teal set under it, which keeps the 20: the owner chooses.
